The level‑payment amount for the 20 000‑dollar loan is found with the standard annuity formula  

\[
\text{PMT}=P\;\frac{i}{1-(1+i)^{-n}}
\]

where  
\(P = \$20{,}000\)  
\(i = 0.06/12 = 0.005\) (monthly rate)  
\(n = 60\) months.

\[
\begin{aligned}
(1+i)^{n} &= (1.005)^{60}\approx 1.3488388\\[4pt]
(1+i)^{-n} &\approx \frac{1}{1.3488388}\approx 0.741378\\[4pt]
1-(1+i)^{-n} &\approx 1-0.741378 = 0.258622
\end{aligned}
\]

Now

\[
\text{PMT}=20000 \times \frac{0.005}{0.258622}
          = 20000 \times 0.0193415
          \approx 386.66
\]

Rounded to the nearest cent, the scheduled monthly payment is

\[
\boxed{\$386.66}
\]
